_meta.description: Beat score for transformation — rigid motions in 3D. Translation, rotation, scale. The player learns the three primary transformations + their composition, ending in the Trans_Pit limit case.

beats.concept: arrival from primitives — the static shape is about to move
the three rigid motions — translation, rotation, scale; the grammar of motion
beats.note: reciprocates primitives.P7 bleed — the static cube finds its mover

beats.concept: translation — sliding along an axis without changing form
axis decomposition — translation along x, y, z separately
rotation — the circle hidden inside motion
beats.note: rotation foreshadows wavefunctions — the unit circle returns there

beats.concept: rotation spectacle — the range of rotational expression, dramatized
Trans_Pit — when transformations compose against geometry; the architectural pit where motion is constrained
beats.note: the limit of pure rigid motion — anticipates the crisis phase

beats.concept: synthesis — the player carries translation + rotation + scale forward as a unified vocabulary
beats.note: rigid motion seeds randomness.R5 — random XYZ rotation is the entropic descendant
